newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish police close traffic to Islamist protest.
newsitem.headline: Turkish police close traffic to Islamist protest.

text.p: Turkish police banned traffic from the centre of the capital on Tuesday to prevent Islamist protesters from demonstrating at parliament against planned education reforms, Anatolian news agency said.
It said police acted after convoys of cars carrying Islamist protesters began gathering at two main mosques in Ankara in the early morning.
The Islamists had planned to march on parliament to protest at government attempts to extend secularist school education in a bill that would effectively close religious schools.
Eleven people were arrested at a demonstration against the plans outside an Istanbul mosque at the weekend.
